name: Organization of American States

colors.symbolism: the central disc bearing the seal

description: A blue field with a central white disc bearing the seal of the Organization of American States — the flagstaffs of the member states arranged in a fan.
history: The Organization of American States was founded in 1948 in Bogotá, Colombia. The flag bears the OAS seal, with vertical flagpoles representing the member states.

features.role: Seal of the Organization of American States (the member states' flags on crossed staffs)
